column3: a soft plush bunny toy about 30 cm tall: long pink ears with light-pink inner ears, cream face with big glossy black embroidered eyes, tiny pink nose and smile, a yellow petal-shaped hood framing the face like a sunflower, pink velvet body with a yellow scalloped collar, an embroidered yellow sunflower with green stem and cursive 'Sun flower' text on the tummy, cream paws and feet. Sitting upright, straight front view.

a decorative table showpiece: a glossy mirror-chrome gold ceramic open ring sculpture standing on a black rectangular plinth base, with a stylised faceless figure seated cross-legged in a yoga pose with palms joined in namaste inside the ring; the figure has a glossy white upper body and gold legs.

ONLY the pink kitten lamp in the hand (ignore the panda, Spiderman and other items): a kids' rechargeable LED desk lamp shaped like a cute pastel-pink kitten camera - rounded pink body with cat ears (one ear with a little bow), kawaii cat face with blush and whiskers, a peach-coral camera lens ring on the front, a flexible white gooseneck arm rising from the back ending in a round coral lamp head with a glowing white LED disc.

a cordless rechargeable table lamp: brushed brass-gold cylindrical base with a rounded shoulder, a slim rose-gold stem, a frosted opal-white glass drum shade with a polished rose-gold top disc. Remove the price sticker.
a cordless rechargeable bistro table lamp in brushed brass-gold: a conical metal shade on a slender tapered column with a flared round base. Remove the price sticker.

a wall clock with a champagne-ivory brushed metallic rounded-square case, white dial with raised gold Arabic numerals and exposed gold skeleton gears in the centre, black hour and minute hands. Straight-on front view. Remove the price sticker.
a round wall clock with a black outer rim and thin gold inner bezel, light washed-wood dial with large black Arabic numerals, decorative gold gears in the centre, black hands. Straight-on front view.
a women's caramel-tan pebbled vegan-leather handbag with a soft slouchy knotted top handle, a large front flap with a small silver metal emblem, structured boxy body. No hand.
a large cream off-white canvas tote bag with black webbing handles fixed with black metal rivets and a horizontal zip pocket on the front. Remove the plastic wrap on the handles.

a handmade crochet flower bouquet: three crochet sunflowers with brown centres and orange-gold petals, cream-and-yellow crochet roses, crochet green leaves, and a fluffy yellow plush chick with an orange beak peeking out in the middle, wrapped in mint-aqua and white floral wrapping-paper cones, tied with a cream satin ribbon bow with long trailing ribbons. Bouquet standing upright, no hand.
an artificial flower arrangement in a pastel-pink ceramic pot tied with a jute twine bow: blush-pink and cream peonies and roses, small pink lily blossoms and soft green leaves.

an artificial flower arrangement in a small woven wicker-look basket with a round handle and a cream heart-shaped patch with 'I Love You' in script on the front; flowers: a large peach chrysanthemum, blush-pink peonies, small white blooms and soft sage-green leaves.

a plush bag charm keychain about 15 cm: a cute fluffy character wearing a lavender bunny-ear hood with a small pink skull emblem and lilac ribbon bows, white face with pink eyes, wearing a sheer glittery pink tulle dress with pink and white pom-poms, hanging from a gold metal ring and lobster-clasp chain at the top. No hand.

a fuchsia-pink cotton baseball cap with a curved brim, white contrast stitching lines on the brim, six panels and a top button, three-quarter view. Completely plain: NO logos, NO brand text, NO tags or labels anywhere.

ONE single necklace from the tray: a dainty gold-tone chain necklace with a small glossy red enamel heart pendant. Lay it in an elegant soft curve on the background, seen from directly above, pendant at the bottom centre.

ONE single necklace from the tray: a dainty gold-tone chain necklace with a small faceted emerald-green drop stone pendant in a gold bezel. Lay it in an elegant soft curve on the background, seen from directly above, pendant at the bottom centre.

a white glossy porcelain footed teacup with a cute cartoon kitten face (black oval eyes, yellow nose, pink blush cheeks, whiskers) and a big red bow printed on the side, a playful handle made of stacked glossy red beads, and a matching stirring spoon topped with a big glossy red ball resting in the cup. No hand.

a square kids' lunch box with rounded corners in teal green, with a cartoon dinosaur face: a big white googly eye, a blue eye patch, brown snout with white triangle teeth and a big smile, 'SUPER DINO SAUR!' lettering in yellow-green at top left, small ridges along the top edge. Remove the shrink wrap and the hand.

an executive desk perpetual calendar and pen stand: matte black rectangular block with a rotating circular date dial (white numbers 1-31, month and weekday rings) and a gold sliding window marker, a small gold-rimmed analog clock inset in a black pen-holder cube at the left, all on a brushed gold metal base plate. No hand.

ONLY the white-and-colour idol in the centre (ignore the blue idol at the left): a hand-painted resin idol of Lord Krishna playing the flute - serene face with eyes closed, ornate turban in orange, red and yellow with a peacock feather, white tilak, gold jewellery, a twisted maroon-and-gold flute with tassel, holding pink lotus buds, green and white draped stole, seated on a textured bronze-gold rock base. Respectful, devotional, premium.
a large heart-shaped wooden gift box with a lid that opens in two halves down the middle, hand-painted red distressed finish, white script text 'Best for you' at the lower right. No hand.

a set of two matching vertical framed wall art panels in light oak frames, side by side: teal-blue and white backgrounds with gold-foil and dark-navy tropical palm leaves, scattered gold dots and small gold round medallions. Remove the cardboard corner protectors and plastic.

a clear acrylic gift hamper bag with gold twisted rope handles, filled with: a pink satin ribbon bow printed 'Just for you', a small white plush bunny, pink and white crochet flowers, a sky-blue insulated bottle (plain, no name on it), a jewellery card with a delicate necklace, a beauty card, and pink shredded paper fill at the bottom. No hand.
a butter-yellow matte insulated stainless-steel water bottle about 750 ml, with a white flip-top sipper lid, a pastel pink collar and a rose-copper curved carry handle. No hand.

a handmade crochet snowman keychain bag charm: white crochet body, red knit beanie with a white pom-pom, red-and-white striped scarf, orange carrot nose, black bead eyes and buttons, small gold keyring on top. No hand.
a round woven paper-rope gift basket in coral pink with a looped handle and two tall woven bunny ears rising from the rim.

a 100 ml eau de parfum bottle: heavy clear glass with a rounded bell-dome shape fading from frosted white at the top to clear at the base, wrapped over the top by a taupe-brown leather strap with white contrast stitching, gold grommets and a polished round gold monogram medallion; 'EAU DE PARFUM 100ml' printed small near the base. No hand.
